summary: Implements the Pydantic AI provider integration for gyomu_ai, providing components for AI model registries, agent creation, prompt building, model execution, routing, and mapping between Pydantic AI and standard AI results, errors, and tools.
responsibilities: Integrate Pydantic AI functionality including model registries, agent creation, prompt building, and execution.
Map Pydantic AI errors, results, finish reasons, and tools to standard formats.
Configure model settings, Google API integration, and model routing.
design_decisions: Integrates Pydantic AI as a provider for AI models, routing, agents, and execution.
